Two things from you so I can book it cleanly:
- **how long** should it be (1 hour? 90 min?), and
- any **day/time you prefer**, or should I take the first slot that works for all three TAs?

I've asked Sarah, John and Priya for their free blocks and the department office for the official schedule, so I don't put it on top of anything.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. Could you send me the **official schedule for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov 2026)** — lectures, seminars and university meetings involving the Professor or CSE455? I'm placing a CSE455 staff meeting and want to avoid clashes with anything official I may not have yet.

An hour is plenty. Take the first slot next week that works for all three TAs — just keep it off my lecture and office-hour times, since those are fixed with the students. If a slot collides with anything on my calendar, tell me and I'll decide.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I'll come back to you if I need anything confirmed.
You're welcome — glad it helped. Just write whenever you need something confirmed.

Back with the answer, and it's not a clean one.

**The three TAs have no 60-minute window in common next week.** Thursday and Friday they're booked solid; Monday has no overlap at all. Their only common free time is **30 minutes** on three slots — and, conveniently, **none of them collides with anything on your calendar**:

1. **Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** — Sarah/John/Priya all free; their first choice, sits just before Sarah's office hours.
2. **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — all free; between your Thesis committee and Grant writing.
3. **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30** — all free; between Research meeting and Guest lecture prep.

Two ways forward:
- **(a) Take 30 minutes** in one of those three — nothing to move, nobody misses it, no student-facing commitment is touched. My recommendation: **Tue 15:00–15:30**.
- **(b) Keep the full hour** and I ask one of them to shift a *non-student-facing* block. Sarah offered her Reading/Study group, John mentioned his reading group; Priya says everything is fixed. That buys us an hour only if one of those really can move, and it costs a favour.

Tell me (a) plus which slot, or (b), and I'll book it and log it.

Let's take (a): Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30. I'd rather not spend a favour on moving someone's reading group for it, and half an hour is enough for a staff meeting if we stay on topic. Book it and log it, please.

**Booked: CSE455 staff meeting — Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** (30 min, Tue lecture-free slot).

- On your calendar: nothing collided — it sits between Grant writing (14:20–15:00) and your 15:30 block, no lecture or office hours touched.
- In `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`: added under Tuesday as `15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting (Sarah, John, Priya)` and logged as `BOOKED: Tue 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John and Priya (CSE455 staff meeting)`. Backup of the file kept as `CALENDAR.md.bak`.
- Sarah, John and Priya have been told to hold it.

One thing I noticed while checking: the department's official list has Tue 15:30–16:20 CSE455 office hours and 16:20–17:00 quiz section, while your calendar shows Research meeting and Guest lecture prep there. Say the word if you want me to reconcile the two.

Good. Leave my calendar as it is — where the two disagree, mine is the one I teach from, and neither of those Tuesday blocks is student-facing on my books. That said, I don't have a quiz section on my schedule, so write to the department office and ask them to confirm what they have listed for me on Tuesday afternoon.

Hello again — a check on **Tuesday afternoon (24 Nov)**, please.

Comparing your list with the Professor's own calendar, three things don't line up:

1. You list **CSE455 quiz section 13:30–14:20** — he has **Thesis committee** there, and says he doesn't have a quiz section on his books at all.
2. You list **CSE455 quiz section 16:20–17:00** — he has **Guest lecture prep**. Same question: is a Tuesday quiz section really his?
3. You list **CSE455 office hours 15:30–16:20** — he has **Research meeting**. Is that office hours slot his, or someone else's?

Also, several entries appear twice on your Tuesday list (CSE455 office hours 12:20–13:30, and 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours next to Guest lecture prep). Are those duplicates, or two separate bookings?

Where the two disagree his own calendar stands for now. Please confirm what you actually have attributed to **Professor Alvarez** on Tuesday afternoon — which office hours are his, whether he teaches any quiz section that day, and which room/listing the 15:30–16:20 entry belongs to. Thanks.

Understood: your calendar stays exactly as it is — your version is what you teach from.

I've written to the department office asking them to confirm what they have listed for you on Tuesday afternoon: whether any quiz section that day is yours, which CSE455 office hours are attributed to you, and who the 15:30–16:20 entry belongs to. I'll report back when they answer. Also noted: their list has some duplicates, so I'll ask them to clean it up.

Happy to clarify. Here is exactly what the official schedule carries for Tuesday 24 Nov, afternoon:

**Attributed to Professor Alvarez:**
- 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee (Prof. Alvarez)
- 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep (Prof. Alvarez)

**CSE455 entries on Tuesday afternoon not attributed to him:**
- 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours (general listing)
- 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section
- 15:30–16:20 CSE455 office hours
- 16:20–17:00 CSE455 quiz section

To your three points:
1. No quiz section is attributed to the Professor on Tuesday. The 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section is a general listing; his name is on Thesis committee at that hour.
2. Same for 16:20–17:00 CSE455 quiz section — general listing, not his; his name is on Guest lecture prep at 16:30–17:00.
3. The 15:30–16:20 slot is a CSE455 office hours listing with no name on it. Nothing in the schedule attributes it to the Professor.

On the apparent duplicates: they are two separate listings, not one repeated. The official schedule carries a CSE455 office hours entry and, alongside it, a second CSE455 office hours entry marked (Prof. Alvarez) — same hour, two bookings. That pattern appears on Tuesday at 12:20–13:30, and also Monday 16:30–17:00 and Friday 15:20–17:00.

So his Tuesday afternoon official commitments are the three above, and no quiz section. I have no room information in the schedule — it lists course, time and, where applicable, the Professor's name; it does not give rooms. If you need rooms, the department's room booking record is the place to check, and where your list and his own calendar disagree, his calendar stands.

That clears it up completely — thank you for the detail. So on Tuesday afternoon the official schedule has the Professor on 12:20–13:30 office hours, 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee and 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep, no quiz section, and the 15:30–16:20 office hours entry is unattributed.

Two small follow-ups, whenever convenient:
- He's now booked for a **CSE455 staff meeting Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** — it doesn't touch any of his three. Fine on your side?
- The same doubling pattern appears Monday 16:30–17:00 and Friday 15:20–17:00 (an unattributed CSE455 office hours listing next to one marked Prof. Alvarez). Worth having someone tidy, since it reads as two bookings. I'll leave that with you.

And noted: his own calendar stands where the two disagree.

Yes — Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear on the official side. Nothing official is on his books between 14:20 and 16:30, so a CSE455 staff meeting there touches none of his three commitments.

On the doubling: noted, and it's the same pattern as you describe — an unattributed CSE455 office hours listing alongside one marked Prof. Alvarez, Monday 16:30–17:00 and Friday 15:20–17:00, plus Tuesday 12:20–13:30. I don't change listings or anyone's bookings myself; it's for whoever maintains the schedule listing to tidy. Until it's changed, I'll keep reporting both entries as they stand.

The department office has answered, and it's clean:

- Their official Tuesday-afternoon entries **for you** are exactly your calendar: 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours, 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee, 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep. **No quiz section is attributed to you on Tuesday.**
- The 13:30–14:20 and 16:20–17:00 quiz sections are general course listings with someone else's name (or none) against them; the 15:30–16:20 office hours listing has no name on it and isn't yours either.
- The apparent duplicates are real double listings (a general CSE455 office hours entry sitting next to one marked "Prof. Alvarez" for the same hour) — same pattern on Mon 16:30–17:00 and Fri 15:20–17:00. I've asked them to tidy it, and they've agreed your own calendar stands where the two disagree.

Nothing to change on your side. The staff meeting at Tue 15:00–15:30 clashes with none of it. No rooms are in their schedule, in case you ever need that.
Perfect — thank you. Noted that you report the listings as they stand and don't edit them yourself; I'll leave the tidying with the schedule maintainer. Nothing further needed from you.
Sounds good — write any time you need something checked.
Perfect, thanks. Nothing to change: Tue 15:00–15:30 stands, and my calendar stays as it is.
